His works are a study of typical American lives in the late twentieth century, and were influenced by the great American playwrights Arthur Miller and Edward Albee.  Edwards' non-fiction books include: "The Coming Cancer Breakthroughs" (2001), "Men Head East, Woman Turn Right" (2006) and "Plays by J.B. Edwards" (2012).  His fiction books include: "Faagraph of an Ordinary Man" and "China Dreams".
